headline: TADB empowers 167 youths to venture into fish farming
summary: 167 young people in Mwanza, Kagera and Mara regions have received TZS 4.3 billion in loans for fish farming. The loans are part of the Building a Better Tomorrow Fisheries Programme with the Tanzania Agricultural Development Bank.
why: The Tanzania Agricultural Development Bank is a state-owned lender that finances agriculture and related enterprises. Its lending shapes rural business development.
